items.headline: Why Baker Mayfield's contract means the QB market could burst
items.description: Baker Mayfield just got $55 million per year in new money -- which is telling about where the QB market is headed. That's great news for 11 other passers ready for big deals.

items.headline: Patriots face uphill battle without A.J. Brown for four weeks
items.description: Brown suffered a high ankle sprain in Week 1 that will keep him out of the lineup. Who will need to step up for the Patriots in his absence?

items.headline: Sources: Patriots' A.J. Brown to go on IR, miss at least 4 games
items.description: The Patriots are placing wide receiver A.J .Brown on injured reserve due to his high ankle sprain, sidelining him for a minimum of four games, sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

items.headline: Sources: Patriots to add DaQuan Jones on 1-year deal
items.description: The Patriots are expected to sign free agent defensive tackle DaQuan Jones to a one-year deal worth up to $6 million, sources told NFL Network.
